mentions.name: Holographic surf forecast display
mentions.description: A microcontroller-based “holographic” display device that shows the surf forecast for any beach, built as a side tinkering project with AI coding tools; the casing and mechanical parts were built by a friend.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built this little “holographic” display that shows the surf forecast for any beach. While my friend built the casing, and mechanical part of it
